record.paper_title: Open Problems in Computability Theory and Descriptive Set Theory
record.original_question: Let A be a subset of the real numbers, and define I(A) to be the set of gauge functions f such that the Hausdorff measure H^f(A) is positive. Determine the possible complexity and set-theoretic behavior of the map A ↦ I(A): (1) does the range of I have the same cardinality as 2^R; (2) for closed sets C, the set I(C) is arithmetic (Σ^0_2), but what is the complexity of the set of Σ^0_2 formulas φ such that φ defines I(C) for some closed set C, and is this set Σ^1_2-complete; (3) is the statement that the Borel hierarchy is proper with respect to the range of I independent of ZFC; and (4) is it consistent with ZFC that whenever H^f(A) > 0 there is a subset A0 of A such that H^f(A0) is finite and positive?

evidence.quote: Given A ⊆ R. Define I(A) = {f gauge function : Hf(A) > 0}.

Problem 1. Natural questions about A 7→ I(A): (1) Does the range of I have the same cardinality as 2R? ... (2) ... What’s the complexity of the set {Σ0_2 formula φ : φ defines an I(C) for some C}? Is it Σ1_2-complete? ... (3) Is the answer to 'Borel hierarchy is proper w.r.t. the range of I' independent of ZFC? (4) Is it consistent with ZFC that for every f and A ⊆ R, if Hf(A) > 0, then there is a subset A0 such that Hf(A0) is finite and positive?

artifact.category_tag: Hausdorff gauge functions and descriptive set theory
artifact.self_contained_problem:
A gauge function is a non-decreasing right-continuous function $f:[0,\infty)\to[0,\infty)$ with $f(0)=0$ and $f(t)>0$ for $t>0$. For a set $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ and a gauge function $f$, the $f$-Hausdorff measure of $A$ is
\[ H^f(A)=\lim_{\delta\to 0^+}\inf\Big\{\sum_{i=1}^\infty f(\mathrm{diam}(U_i)) : A\subseteq\bigcup_i U_i,\ \mathrm{diam}(U_i)\le\delta\Big\}. \]
For $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}$, define
\[ I(A)=\{f\text{ a gauge function} : H^f(A)>0\}. \]
Investigate the map $A\mapsto I(A)$:

(1) Does the range $\{I(A) : A\subseteq\mathbb{R}\}$ have cardinality $2^{\mathfrak{c}}=|\mathcal{P}(\mathbb{R})|$?

(2) For every closed $C\subseteq\mathbb{R}$, the set $I(C)$ (viewed in a suitable Polish coding of gauge functions) is $\Sigma^0_2$. Determine the descriptive-set-theoretic complexity of
\[ \{\varphi : \varphi\text{ is a }\Sigma^0_2\text{ formula and }\varphi\text{ defines }I(C)\text{ for some closed }C\subseteq\mathbb{R}\}. \]
Is this set $\Sigma^1_2$-complete?

(3) Is the statement "the Borel hierarchy is proper when restricted to the range of $I$" independent of ZFC?

(4) Is it consistent with ZFC that for every gauge function $f$ and every $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ with $H^f(A)>0$, there exists $A_0\subseteq A$ with $0<H^f(A_0)<\infty$?
